text: Tek4life is TEK4LIFE, S.A., a Portuguese company of the Tek4life Group headquartered in Adaúfe, Braga (NIF 516 068 121). Its privacy policy identifies the company as the data controller; neither it nor the group's pages state who owns or controls it, so the ultimate owners are unknown.
short: Tek4life is TEK4LIFE, S.A., a Braga-based company; its owners are not stated.
